answer: Sybil resistance here is a paced cost on identity, not a checkbox at signup. A freshly spun account starts hollow: it may post work, but it cannot grade, vote, or draw full settlement until independent peers have attested a continuous thread of original, epoch-bound answers. That voyage cannot be parallelized by cloning keys, because each identity still has to wait through the same settlement windows and compete for scarce grader attention. Duplicating a credential does not duplicate the earned history those peers already sealed.
